boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Denver, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence of campus landmarks, student resources, and recurring cultural options for getting oriented.

cards.title: Start at the Community Commons
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Meet your group in the central student hub, then use its dining, gathering, and student-service spaces to decide the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A practical first meeting point with food, lounges, and student services in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: DU describes Community Commons as a central hub for student activity with dining, social spaces, meeting rooms, and student services.
cards.access_notes: Campus destination; check building access and individual venue availability before visiting.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal together
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Community Commons
cards.notes: Use the central dining hall as an easy regrouping stop; check the current menu and service status before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: DU’s central campus dining hall is built into Community Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: DU identifies the Rebecca Chopp Grand Central Market as the central campus dining hall in Community Commons.
cards.access_notes: Food is purchased or covered through an applicable meal plan; verify current dining service before going.

cards.title: Cross the Evans Pedestrian Bridge
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · between Community Commons and Driscoll Commons
cards.notes: Walk the named bridge between the two commons buildings and use the crossing to orient yourself to Evans Avenue and campus services.
cards.short_summary: A named pedestrian connection linking DU’s two commons buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: DU states that the Evans Pedestrian Bridge connects Driscoll Commons and Community Commons.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor pedestrian route; use normal campus pedestrian safety practices.

cards.title: Find the main library before classes begin
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus study stop
cards.notes: Locate the main library, identify an entrance and a study floor, and save it as a dependable place for your first academic week.
cards.short_summary: The map-listed main library gives a new student a useful academic anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: DU’s campus map lists Anderson Academic Commons as the Main Library.
cards.access_notes: Confirm library access and service hours on the University Libraries website before planning a long study session.

cards.title: Add Buchtel Memorial Tower to your walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · campus landmark stop
cards.notes: Use the tower as a recognizable waypoint while walking the academic core, then continue toward nearby library and classroom buildings.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed campus landmark that helps make the central walk legible.
cards.evidence_claim: DU’s campus map lists Buchtel Memorial Tower among campus buildings and greens.
cards.access_notes: View from public outdoor areas; do not assume interior access.

cards.title: Pause at Evans Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · campus landmark stop
cards.notes: Include the chapel on a daylight campus loop and note its location for future ceremonies, quiet reflection, or a photo with friends.
cards.short_summary: A named campus chapel on DU’s official map.
cards.evidence_claim: DU’s campus map lists Evans Chapel as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is the reliable plan; confirm whether the chapel is open before seeking indoor access.

cards.title: Try a recreation session at Coors
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Daniel L. Ritchie Center
cards.notes: Bring your Pioneer ID, ask the front desk about student entry, and choose a simple activity such as open recreation or lap swimming.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility offering fitness, open basketball, lap swimming, and other activities.
cards.evidence_claim: DU says actively enrolled students may use Coors Fitness Center and lists group fitness, open recreation basketball, and open lap swimming.
cards.access_notes: Full-time students in the current term are eligible for free access and must use a DU ID to sign in; confirm activity schedules first.

cards.entity_name: Robert and Judi Newman Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check the Newman Center calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · performance option
cards.notes: Look for a performance that fits your weekend and reserve only if the listed program, ticket availability, and timing work for your group.
cards.short_summary: A campus performing-arts venue with a published presenting-season lineup.
cards.evidence_claim: DU publishes a Newman Center Presents season and directs visitors to purchase tickets and season passes for listed performances.
cards.source_title: Newman Center Unveils Lineup for 2026–27 Season | University of Denver
cards.access_notes: Admission, age guidance, and performance times vary by event; use the current event listing before making plans.

cards.title: Plan a Chamberlin Observatory open house
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Observatory Park
cards.notes: Check the Denver Astronomical Society schedule, then attend a monthly lawn open house when it aligns with your weekend instead of arriving unannounced.
cards.short_summary: A DU-operated observatory near campus with recurring public astronomy outreach.
cards.evidence_claim: DU says Chamberlin Observatory’s monthly open houses include free lawn telescopes and require no registration.
cards.access_notes: Monthly open houses are free and need no registration; public nights have limited seats and require advance registration, with pricing set by the host.

cards.title: Finish by locating Driscoll Commons services
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · practical campus reset
cards.notes: Walk through Driscoll Commons and note the Food Pantry, Pioneer ID Card Office, disability services, and bookstore for future reference.
cards.short_summary: A service-focused commons building connected to Community Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: DU lists the Food Pantry, Pioneer ID Card Office, Student Disability Services, bookstore, and bank among Driscoll Commons services.
cards.access_notes: Service availability varies by office; verify individual office hours before making a special trip.
